name: transcript-tool-error-line
opens_with: (agent script only — no keystroke opens it)
notes: A tool FAILURE inside an otherwise successful turn. Distinct from transcript-assistant-message because the error text must survive into the flushed assistant message and must be styled differently from ordinary content — a regression that swallowed ToolError, or that rendered it as a normal assistant line, shows up here. Complements the blocked `tool-block` scenario, which covers the tool BLOCK; this covers the error SURFACING in the transcript.
